description: Highest civilian honours of India + notable recipients

questions.explanation: Bharat Ratna — instituted 2 January 1954 by President Rajendra Prasad. India's highest CIVILIAN award. Max 3 recipients per year historically (rule relaxed later). Not a title — no 'Mr. Bharat Ratna' prefix.
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Bharat Ratna & civilian awards — mixed tiers

questions.stem: The FIRST POSTHUMOUS Bharat Ratna was awarded (1966) to:
questions.explanation: Lal Bahadur Shastri — India's 2nd PM, died in Tashkent on 11 January 1966. Bharat Ratna awarded posthumously the same year — first POSTHUMOUS. Gandhi was never conferred Bharat Ratna. Nehru received it IN 1955 (during his lifetime).
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Bharat Ratna & civilian awards — mixed tiers

questions.stem: The YOUNGEST PERSON to receive the Bharat Ratna was:
questions.explanation: Sachin Tendulkar — conferred Bharat Ratna in 2014 at age 40 — first sports person + youngest recipient. Also the first for whom the award was extended by broadening the criteria (originally 'arts, literature, science, public service'; sports added in 2011). at 40, in 2014.

questions.stem: The ONLY NON-INDIAN to receive Bharat Ratna (1980) was:
questions.explanation: Mother Teresa — Indian citizen since 1948, awarded Bharat Ratna in 1980. First non-Indian-origin Bharat Ratna: Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan (1987). Nelson Mandela — 1990 (second foreigner). Option phrasing is a bit long-winded to cover the common-exam framing. not quite 'non-Indian'. Actual non-Indian: Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan (1987) + Nelson Mandela (1990); Indian citizen, 1980.

questions.stem: Match the PADMA award with its RANK. A. Padma Vibhushan.  B. Padma Bhushan.  C. Padma Shri.  D. Bharat Ratna. List-II: 1. 2nd highest civilian award.  2. 3rd highest.  3. 4th highest.  4. Highest civilian award.
questions.explanation: India's civilian awards order (highest to lowest): Bharat Ratna > Padma Vibhushan > Padma Bhushan > Padma Shri. Padma awards instituted 1954. For gallantry: Param Vir Chakra > Maha Vir Chakra > Vir Chakra (wartime). Ashoka Chakra > Kirti Chakra > Shaurya Chakra (peacetime).
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Bharat Ratna & civilian awards — mixed tiers

questions.stem: The FIRST Bharat Ratna awarded to a SPORTS PERSON was:
questions.explanation: Sachin Tendulkar — first Bharat Ratna in sports, 2014. Criteria were expanded in 2011 to include sports. Milkha Singh, P.T. Usha, Abhinav Bindra received Padma awards but not Bharat Ratna.
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Bharat Ratna & civilian awards — mixed tiers

questions.stem: The first WOMAN to receive Bharat Ratna was:
questions.explanation: Indira Gandhi — first WOMAN Bharat Ratna (1971, during her tenure as PM). Mother Teresa (1980) was the second woman. Aruna Asaf Ali — posthumous Bharat Ratna in 1997. Sarojini Naidu — pre-dated the award.
